chapter: Mario Bauza and the Cuban sextets
title: Being fired by Maria Teresa Vera
summary: After two years Vera dismissed him because he rehearsed with a radio quartet and she thought he would quit.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: You were with Maria Teresa Vera first, Correct?
Yes
All right then; How long did you stay with her?
Two years.
And - ah - those two years, Did you travel around with the group, or did you stay in one place?
No, we were - was in one particular place.
Okay. What made you leave Maria Teresa Vera in 1928 or 29?

Because I - ah - there was a kind of misunderstanding because I was rehearsing with a quartet to broadcast and she thought that I was going to leave, so she was two or three steps ahead of me in her way of thinking and she just gave me the notice.
Okay, you were rehearsing with a group that was going to go on the radio.
Uh - Hum
So she thought......
Just for broadcasting and she thought that I am going to quit.
So she thought you were going to quit. Were you going to quit?
No.
No. You just wanted to sing and make some extra money.
Make some extra money and some kind of experiment with a different type of music.
Okay, so then Maria Teresa Vera fired you because you were rehearsing with another group?
Yes and she thought that I was going to quit the group.
She thought you were going to quit.
Yes, so she brought somebody to play, a good one, Panchito, Panchito El Moro, good maraca player; so from there I went to - to Barroso, with The Agabama.
